title: Learning Rate
subtext: Controls how fast a model updates its weights during training
author: Buzzpy

description.title: Learning Rate
texts: The learning rate is a hyperparameter that controls how large the weight updates are during training. After the backward pass computes gradients, the learning rate scales those gradients before applying them to the model's weights.

A learning rate that is too high causes the model to overshoot the optimal weights — loss becomes unstable or diverges. A rate that is too low makes training very slow and risks getting stuck in a poor solution.

Typical learning rates range from 1e-5 to 1e-1 depending on the task and model. Techniques like learning rate schedulers and warmup strategies adjust the learning rate dynamically over the course of training.
